parameters.objective: within-position pairwise logistic ranking of teacher preferences on top of production scores; equal total weight per root
parameters.tuning: One fixed fit, no held-out hyperparameter selection or refitting after tournaments. Production is the zero-delta baseline.

scope: Internal rounded teacher score regret on retained grouped development roots; not win probability, not independent strength validation.
measurement_correction: Initial report used teacher-style parent-favored tie breaking. Corrected to native strict-first-maximum enumeration; no training/model/header change.
